risk_description: Due to damage to the heating/ventilation/air conditioning (HVAC) harness caused by contact with the clutch pedal, the air conditioning may be activated automatically. This could lead to a fire as a result of a short circuit in the wires.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
